data.title: Carrick takes the blame as troubled Man Utd suffer League Cup misery
data.description: MANCHESTER (UNITED KINGDOM) - Michael Carrick took the blame for Manchester United's stunning League Cup collapse against Brighton after furious fans jeered his side at Old Trafford on Wednesday.

data.title: Mbappe explains Ceuta shirt stance after criticism
data.description: BARCELONA - Real Madrid superstar Kylian Mbappe said on Wednesday that he wanted to make a gesture in support of immigrants who had lost their lives by not wearing a t-shirt in support of the people of Ceuta properly.

data.title: Lanlana quits squad for her LA28 dream
data.description: Thailand's No.1 tennis player Lanlana Tararudee has withdrawn from the Asian Games team as she aims to focus on improving her world ranking to boost her chance of qualifying for the 2028 Olympic Games.

data.title: Thais complete stunning comeback
data.description: Paripan Wongsa struck twice to complete a remarkable turnaround as Thailand came from two goals down to beat Kyrgyzstan 3-2 in their opening Group A match in the 20th Asian Games men's football tournament at Toyota Stadium in Japan on Wednesday.

data.title: Buriram hold on for a point at Johor
data.description: Thai League champions Buriram United came away with a point after a 1-1 draw with Malaysia's Johor Darul Ta'zim at Sultan Ibrahim Stadium in the opening round of the AFC Champions League Elite 2026-27 league phase on Tuesday night.

data.title: ONE Championship: Suriyanlek ‘extremely lucky’ as he resumes training after van accident
data.description: Thai fighter Suriyanlek Por Yenying says he feels “extremely lucky” to be back in training after being hit by a van while out running, with the accident giving him fresh motivation to chase a full-time ONE Championship contract.

data.title: ONE Championship: Jonathan Haggerty’s 48-hour Bangkok dash before Akimoto fight – ‘back to work’
data.description: Jonathan Haggerty had barely unpacked from Tokyo when he turned around and headed back to Asia for barely 48 hours – paying for a business-class ticket himself to limit the physical toll of another long-haul journey during fight camp, without sacrificing a day of training.

data.title: Messi set for Argentina farewell in Benin friendly
data.description: BUENOS AIRES (ARGENTINA) - Lionel Messi was on Tuesday named in Argentina's squad for a friendly against Benin on October 6, a match that will serve as his farewell appearance after announcing his international retirement last month.

data.title: The Bernhard Langer I quite foolishly turned down
data.description: 'No, I can't', l said to a member, who had a 17-year-old Bernhard Langer standing next to him and who was asking if I would like to join them for a game. This reply will haunt me right up until l leave this planet, but at the time I was busy and the thought of playing with this scrawny anaemic-looking German kid was not too appealing.

data.title: Port aim to scalp Japanese giants Vissel in big ACL test
data.description: Port will have to be at their best when they face Vissel Kobe in the AFC Champions League Elite 2026-27 today.

data.title: Buoyant spikers eye elusive volleyball gold
data.description: A little over two weeks after their Asian Championship victory and a historic first-ever Olympic qualification, the Thai women's volleyball team begin their quest for Asian Games glory on Wednesday.

data.title: Chalermcharn, Thatdao named flag bearers
data.description: Equestrian athlete Chalermcharn Yotviriyapanit and volleyball star Thatdao Nuekjang have been selected as the Thai flag bearers to lead the delegation into the stadium during the opening ceremony of the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, on Saturday.

data.title: Thais ready to roar in Aichi
data.description: Thailand's men's football team begin their 20th Asian Games campaign on Wednesday against Kyrgyzstan at the Toyota Stadium in Aichi, with coach Thawatchai Damrong-ongtrakul insisting his side can mount a serious challenge in a group that also features hosts Japan.

data.title: Thailand launchpad for unbeaten Chen
data.description: Professional boxing can be expensive, especially for young fighters without major promotional backing. For developing professionals looking for regular activity and affordable training, Thailand have become an increasingly attractive option.

data.title: Nairobi to host 2029 world athletics championships
data.description: PARIS - Nairobi will host the 2029 world outdoor athletics championships, beating off competition from London, Munich and Rome to become the first African hosts, World Athletics announced on Tuesday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Freddie Haggerty offers Johan Ghazali flyweight fight – after ‘a couple wins’
data.description: Freddie Haggerty says he is willing to move up to flyweight to fight Johan Ghazali in ONE Championship – but wants him to pick up “a couple wins” before entertaining the match-up.

data.title: ONE Championship: Xavier Gonzalez hints at rematch as Thway Lin Htet backs judges
data.description: Xavier Gonzalez has fuelled talk of an immediate rematch with Thway Lin Htet in ONE Championship after telling the Bangkok Post “100” when asked if his newly signed next fight would reunite the pair.

data.title: Asian Games set for liftoff but will have everyone have a bed?
data.description: NAGOYA — The Asian Games open in Japan on Saturday with 2028 Olympics places up for grabs, fast-rising talents of world sport in action and thousands of athletes staying on a cruise ship in typhoon season.

data.title: Leeds thrash Newcastle to go third in the Premier League
data.description: LEEDS (UNITED KINGDOM) - Leeds demolished Newcastle 4-1 to climb up to third in the Premier League table on Monday and inflict a punishing first defeat for Magpies boss Matthias Jaissle.

data.title: Taekwondo minus pain, plus the gain
data.description: There will be no head guards, no body protectors and no risk of a broken toe in this new event -- an Asian Games taekwondo bout with none of the physical contact.

data.title: Hudson picks strongest Asean Cup squad
data.description: The Football Association of Thailand (FAT) has announced a 23-man squad for the inaugural Fifa Asean Cup, which will be held in Indonesia later this month.

data.title: ONE Championship: Seksan finally yields to Father Time in emotional Lumpinee farewell
data.description: The heavens opened over Lumpinee Stadium. Inside, the tears soon followed.

data.title: Beds too short in 'worst-ever' Asian Games rooms, say South Korea
data.description: TOKYO - Accommodation at the Asian Games starting this week in Japan is the "worst ever", South Korean officials told AFP on Monday, also warning of "a serious shortage" of rooms.

data.title: Zverev holds off Shelton to win US Open title
data.description: NEW YORK - Alexander Zverev held off Ben Shelton to win the US Open on Sunday, capturing the second Grand Slam of his career just months after winning the French Open.

data.title: World championship leader Antonelli wins Spanish GP
data.description: MADRID - Kimi Antonelli extended his lead in the world championship with his eighth victory of the season at the Spanish Formula One Grand Prix at the Madring on Sunday.

data.title: Thais target strong start against Japan
data.description: Thailand's women's football team are determined to put on a good performance against defending champions Japan in the first group game at the Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 on Monday, said head coach Natipong Srithong-in.

data.title: Magno's late magic helps Pathum snatch first victory
data.description: BG Pathum United picked up their first win of the season when they defeated Rasisalai United 3-2 in the Thai League 1 on Saturday night.

data.title: Sahasawat soars to PGA title
data.description: Sahasawat Ariyachatvakin claimed his first Thailand PGA Tour title, winning the Singha-SAT Nakhon Ratchasima 2026 on Friday.

data.title: Robinho strikes late as Buriram drop points
data.description: Robinho Junior's second-half goal denied defending champions Buriram United a home victory, while Port picked up their second successive win in the Thai League 1 on Friday night.

data.title: Kop's back as Liverpool fans set to paint Bangkok red for massive run
data.description: Liverpool's Kop Run Bangkok 2026 will take place on Sunday at Plaza Court, Rajamangala National Stadium.
